functions.description: Parse base ESX log line into timestamp, host, process, optional Hostd/Vpxa bracket metadata, and message body
Extract user/src_ip from Hostd login/logout events
Extract user/src_ip/src_port from sshd authentication attempts

functions.filter: message && message.match(/Authentication failed|locked out|disconnected from vCenter|Failed to connect to host/)
functions.description: Extract user/ip/port fields from authentication failures, account lockouts, vCenter disconnects, and host connect failures

conf.regex: /(Authentication failed for user (?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>[0-9a-fA-F:.]+))|(Account (?<locked_user>\S+) locked out after \d+ failed login attempts from (?<locked_src_ip>[0-9a-fA-F:.]+))|(disconnected from vCenter (?<dst_ip>[0-9a-fA-F:.]+))|(Failed to connect to host (?<connect_dst_ip>[0-9a-fA-F:.]+) on port (?<dst_port>\d+))/

functions.description: Normalize scratch fields into consistent user/src_ip/dst_ip, derive protocol, severity, action, and epoch _time

add.name: action
add.value: message && message.match(/Failed password|Authentication failed|locked out|Failed to connect|disconnected|access denied|refused/) ? 'failure' : (message && message.match(/Accepted|logged __e['in']|Task Completed|HostSync complete/) ? 'success' : 'info')
